messages:
vera: Quick alert for month-close FX treatment. Our EMEA deferred revenue bucket was revalued using EUR-USD spot 1.08 but the billing-run used 1.05 when invoicing. Net FX hit in Nov looks like ~€52k (USD ~56,160) causing a recognition mismatch.

matt: Oof. Do you have transaction examples?

vera: Example: deferred_item_id=DR-55421 original_amt_eur=52000 rev_schedule=ratable_3mo invoice_run_fx=1.05 -> recorded USD=54,600. Reval_fx=1.08 -> USD=56,160. Delta USD=1,560 for that line. Aggregated ~56,160 across all impacted deferred items.

acct-bot: Ticket FIN-9801 created: "fx-reval-deferred-revenue-variance" assignee=vera.

matt: How did reval run? Was this NetSuite revaluation or our month-close script?

vera: It's our month-close revaluation job `scripts/fx_reval.py` which runs against `deferred_balances` and posts FX adjustments to GL account 6500 FXGainLoss. It used the bank spot feed at 00:00 UTC; the billing-run had a cached rate from 2 days prior.

sylvia: For close, we need to (1) quantify the P&L FX impact, (2) consider reclassifying the portion that affected recognized revenue to correct period, and (3) decide on JE treatment: post FXGainLoss or adjust deferred balances vs recognized revenue.

matt: Audit preference is to post FX on the balance sheet (deferred) and not on recognized revenue if the FX change relates to deferred items that haven't been recognized yet. But if the invoice amount was already recognized in USD earlier, we may need to post the FX into P&L. Need scope.

vera: Ran SQL to scope: `select count(1), sum(original_eur) from deferred_items where currency='EUR' and period_end between '2028-11-01' and '2028-11-30' and fx_rate_used != bank_spot_rate;` Result: count=38 sum_eur=52000. Total USD delta using bank_spot=1.08 vs invoice_rate=1.05 = 56,160.

acct-bot: FIN-9801 updated: scope=38 items usd_delta=56160.

matt: Proposed JE for close: POST reval to balance sheet: DR 2100 DeferredRevenue 56,160 / CR 6500 FXGainLoss 56,160 dated 2028-11-30. That moves the reval off P&L now and keeps recognition unaffected. Then when those items recognize in future periods, recognized revenue uses the adjusted USD balances. Agree?

sylvia: That matches accounting viewpoint. But we must check whether any of the impacted items were partially recognized in Nov (i.e., some portion already flowed to revenue). If so, the recognized portion's FX should flow to P&L now.

vera: I checked: 5 of the 38 items had partial recognition this month totaling USD 9,400 of the delta. For those, FX should hit P&L. So split JE: (A) DR 2100 DeferredRevenue 46,760 / CR 6500 FXGainLoss 46,760 (balance sheet reval) and (B) DR 6500 FXGainLoss 9,400 / CR 6000 RecognizedRevenue 9,400 (move FX on recognized portion to P&L reversal).

acct-bot: FIN-9801 updated: proposed_split bs=46760 pl=9400.

matt: CFO sign-off required? Thresholds: any P&L JE >10k needs review, this is 9.4k so below. Good. Vera please prepare JE drafts with memos: reference FIN-9801, include FX rate sources and list of deferred_item_ids.

vera: Drafted JEs in NetSuite: JE-120455 (BS reval DR 2100/CR 6500 46760) and JE-120456 (PL adj DR 6500/CR 6000 9400). Put date 2028-11-30. Attached `reports/fx_reval_2028-11-30.csv`.

treasury-bot: Note: bank spot feed source=ECB_mid 2028-11-30 00:00 UTC rate=1.08; cached billing-run rate=1.05 timestamp=2028-11-28 02:15 UTC.

matt: Approve posting. Also add a control: billing-run should persist the fx_rate_used on invoices and we should snapshot spot feed at invoice time to avoid this class of mismatch.

sylvia: Agreed. Add month-close control to validate `fx_reval.py` against invoice snapshot and fail if diff > 0.5% without manual review.

vera: Posted JE-120455 and JE-120456 in NetSuite (status=posted). FIN-9801 updated: status=resolved resolution="split reval JE posted; billing fx snapshot action created".

acct-bot: FIN-9801 updated: status=resolved je=[JE-120455, JE-120456] attachments=[reports/fx_reval_2028-11-30.csv].

matt: Thanks. Follow-up: please add a ticket to engineering to persist `invoice.fx_rate` and add a nightly check comparing invoice.fx_rate vs bank_spot. We'll track in FIN-9801.

vera: Opening ENG ticket ENG-4589 for fx snapshot + nightly compare. Closing thread when ENG PR merges.
